description:
About the Role

Abnormal AI is looking for a Senior Revenue Accountant to join our Accounting team, reporting to Crystal He. In this role, you will own key areas of the revenue close process, preparing and reviewing audit-ready reconciliations, workpapers, journal entries, and analyses that support monthly close, financial reporting, and external audit requirements. This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced accountant to gain meaningful ownership and exposure to technical revenue accounting in a high-growth SaaS environment, while partnering closely with experienced revenue and technical accounting professionals. The ideal candidate operates independently, exercises strong judgment, and is motivated to strengthen how revenue accounting operates by standardizing processes, enhancing controls, and leveraging automation and AI-enabled workflows to improve efficiency, accuracy, and scalability.

What You Will Do

  • Own the preparation and review of monthly revenue-related reconciliations, rollforwards, and supporting schedules
  • Prepare and review journal entries and flux analyses for revenue, deferred revenue, accounts receivable, commissions, and other related accounts
  • Maintain complete, audit-ready documentation for recurring close activities, including organized workpapers, reconciliations, and supporting evidence
  • Lead assigned revenue close deliverables, ensuring work is completed accurately, timely, and in accordance with established policies and controls
  • Investigate and resolve accounting issues, unusual items, and reconciling differences in partnership with cross-functional stakeholders
  • Support external audits by preparing support, coordinating requests, responding to inquiries, and documenting accounting positions
  • Partner with Deal Desk, FP&A, Legal, and other teams to resolve operational issues and improve upstream process quality
  • Identify and drive opportunities to streamline close activities through standardization, automation, and AI-enabled workflows

Must Haves

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field
  • 4+ years of progressive accounting, audit, or related finance experience
  • Strong knowledge of U.S. GAAP, with demonstrated experience applying ASC 606 to complex contract structures in SaaS industry, including multi-product arrangements, contract modification and non-standard contract terms review.
  • Demonstrated experience owning or leading recurring close activities, reconciliations, and financial analyses in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong analytical skills with excellent attention to detail, and the ability to identify issues, evaluate root causes, and implement solutions with limited oversight
  • Advanced Excel skills, including reconciliations, lookups, and analysis of large datasets

Nice to Have

  • CPA license strongly preferred
  • Experience applying ASC 340-40 to capitalize and amortize of sales commissions
  • Experience at a Big Four public accounting firm, a high-growth pre-IPO company, or a publicly traded technology company
  • Experience with ERP, billing, and close-management systems such as NetSuite, Salesforce, Maxio, or FloQast
  • Experience with leveraging AI and automation tools to improve accounting processes

 

 
 

#LI-LM3

Actual compensation will be determined based on several non-discriminatory factors including skills, experience, qualifications, and geographic location.
In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for bonus or incentive compensation, equity, and a comprehensive benefits package.

Base salary range:
$95,600—$137,500 USD

A note on AI in our process: 
Abnormal AI uses AI-assisted tools to help our recruiting team prepare for candidate interviews. These tools analyze resume content and role requirements to suggest interview questions and areas for the interviewer to explore.They do not make hiring decisions or screen candidates automatically. Every decision about a candidacy is made by a person. Further, if your application is successful and Abnormal AI makes a conditional offer of employment, we will carry out pre-employment checks which must be successfully completed to progress to a final offer. All processes and pre-employment checks are in line with prevailing legislation and Abnormal AI's policies relevant to our security and privacy standards.

Abnormal AI is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.
